annotation.provenance: authored by the implementing agent (DeepSeek Harness) for this evaluation; synthetic English sources with Chinese draft translations
annotation.method: Each source/draft pair was constructed to contain one clearly identifiable serious error (or to be a clean control) in one of the categories number/unit/tag/placeholder/terminology/omission/mistranslation. Drafts are not model output and were not produced by a live translator.
limitations: Not independent expert annotation; no inter-annotator agreement.
Synthetic and short: not a real book corpus.
Only 12 serious-error samples and 6 clean controls.
The scripted reviewer is perfect on gold errors it sees, so the measured recall isolates routing policy, not reviewer-model quality.
